post.description: Erases the credentials kestrel holds for it and every token minted from them, cancels its pending posts with a reason, and cancels the Firings held on it in the same step. The Integration and every Project, Trigger, Event and Workspace that refers to it stay readable; it is never used, changed or enabled again, and no other Integration takes its place. Nothing is done on the external system: the GitHub App, its installation and its keys are untouched, and a request already sent or a credential already issued is not recalled. Retiring a retired Integration changes nothing.

put.summary: Replace a GitHub Integration's App private key.
put.description: The replacement is checked against GitHub first: it must sign as the same App, mint for the same installation and reach the same repository. Only then does it replace the stored key, in one write that bumps the revision, so an installation token minted with the previous key is never handed out afterwards. A replacement that is not accepted, an App that no longer reaches its installation or repository, a rate limit or an outage saves nothing and leaves the previous key in use. Maintenance that lands while GitHub is being asked refuses the replacement with 409. The key is never returned.
